assembly.object_transfer: Prefer a verified low-memory copy of existing local Git objects into the new independent repository when possible. A local clone with no hardlinks can avoid repacking, but is only a candidate after source and configuration inspection. Do not use --shared, --reference, a linked worktree, an objects/info/alternates dependency or a hardlinked object store. Record the actual method and object/connectivity verification.
assembly.explicit_tool_path: Discover and record the exact available Git/tool executable paths. If Node or pnpm version inventory is needed, resolve existing mise-managed binaries explicitly; do not assume shell PATH or install anything. Use process-scoped PATH only, with no shell profile or persistent configuration changes.
assembly.temporary_storage: Use a new task-owned disk-backed temporary directory under /srv/dev, after verifying its backing and capacity. Set TMPDIR only for preparation processes. Do not use or change the nearly full tmpfs /tmp, and do not delete existing temporary data.
assembly.inspect_configuration_before_checkout_or: Read existing Git hook, signing and filter configuration without exposing secrets. Do not disable or bypass them. If normal checkout or commit would execute a forbidden hook/filter/build, require unavailable signing/authentication, rewrite unrelated settings or exceed this source-only scope, stop and preserve the partial checkout.
assembly.remote_recheck: Immediately before assembly, read all four named remote refs and verify exact equality with frozen_sources. Stop if any moves, cannot be verified, or an object/ancestor is missing. Do not silently re-pin.
